summary: Applied the u18 changeset to a stage tree, installed the Angular 16.2 closure under consent (2242 packages, exit 0), and drove two production builds. Recorded RED with 8 itemized demand families and quoted diagnostic counts. Adapter movement: chart.js and jasmine-marbles cell dispositions (both discovered by the resolver refusing the closure) and evalSourceMap/vendorSourceMap added to REMOVED_BUILDER_OPTIONS. Fork lineage verified from GitHub fork metadata and the fork's installed surface measured. Owed: the successor-fork disposition kind is verified but not implemented, entry-components-removal is not wired into the era pipeline, and no parity or determinism claim is reachable while the build is red.
open_questions: The successor-fork EcosystemPackage kind (remove one package name, write another, hand a generic specifier rename to the source pass and the tilde-stylesheet pass) is specified and provenance-verified but not implemented — it needs its own cut.
entry-components-removal exists and is exported but is not called by migrateAngularCliEraWorkspace; wiring it answers 19 TS2345 module literals here and is a separate, generic change.
